fullDescription: A single ANIMATED WEBGL SHADER: Orb, a radial falloff with a noise-perturbed edge. A core and a halo built from two smoothsteps of the radius, where the edge radius is itself perturbed by fbm sampled around the circle so the boundary breathes. It is a full-bleed fragment shader with no page around it, about 4KB, no textures, no images and no animation library, and it reacts to the pointer. Drop it behind a hero, a section or a whole page as a living background. Under prefers-reduced-motion it renders one static frame, and it falls back cleanly where WebGL is absent.

structured.summary: A full-viewport animated WebGL fragment shader called Orb: a radial falloff with a noise-perturbed edge. A core and a halo built from two smoothsteps of the radius, where the edge radius is itself perturbed by fbm sampled around the circle so the boundary breathes. The page contains nothing but the canvas. A shared GLSL preamble provides a hashed value noise, a six-octave fbm and a two-level domain-warp helper; this effect draws on them and adds its own body. Pointer movement raises a smoothed intensity uniform so the effect strengthens under the cursor and relaxes when it leaves.

style.description: Generative light on a committed ground. Every colour is computed per pixel from a clock and a coordinate; nothing is sampled from an image.
style.prompt: Ground #07070A with accents ["#FFDB85", "#FA6B1A"]. There is no typography and no page chrome: the shader is the entire surface. Keep the palette to two or three values so the effect reads as one material rather than a rainbow.

layout_and_structure.description: A single full-viewport canvas, fixed to the viewport, with a hidden fallback panel behind it.

prompts.prompt: One canvas fixed at inset 0 filling the viewport, with html and body at 100 percent height, margin 0 and overflow hidden. Behind it a hidden panel that is only shown when no WebGL context can be created.
